subject: MedXpress: request for custom uptime/latency annex and order form language
messages:
From: Caroline Park <caroline.park@medxpress.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: MedXpress Procurement <procurement@medxpress.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MedXpress: request for custom uptime/latency annex and order form language

Hi Jonas / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency profiles and the regional failover description. Our procurement team has asked me to request a formal addendum that: 1) codifies a regional uptime commitment for our primary US region, 2) defines latency tiers and associated credits for 95th/99th percentiles, and 3) describes the exception path (notification, mitigation windows, and credit calculation).

Specific asks from procurement:
- Draft SLA annex we can attach to our MSA/SOW or order form (redline-friendly PDF).
- A short evidence checklist (telemetry points, retention, runbooks) to satisfy our security/compliance gate.
- Suggested order form language for availability/latency line items (plain text snippet to paste into our purchase order).

Our timeline: we need an initial draft to circulate internally by EOB Friday 10/01 so procurement can kick the review. Can you also confirm whether you can accommodate a phased rollout (start with 2 regions, then add failover region) and whether that affects the credit schedule?

I've attached our standard procurement template for reference.

Thanks — I can be on a quick call today if that's easier.

Best,
Caroline Park
Director, Cloud Ops & Procurement
MedXpress
[Attachment: procurement_template.pdf]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Park <caroline.park@medxpress.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedXpress: request for custom uptime/latency annex and order form language

Caroline —

Appreciate the clear asks and the timeline. Attaching a first-pass SLA annex (PDF) and an evidence checklist that maps telemetry and runbook artifacts to each subsection. Also included a short order-form snippet you can paste into your PO for availability and latency tiers. High-level notes:

- We can support a phased rollout starting with US-West (primary) + US-East (failover) and add an additional failover region on a 30-day cadence; the credit schedule below reflects staged ramp percentages.
- Latency tiers in the snippet use 95th/99th p95/p99 windows with tokenized credit bands; happy to rework the bands if you have a different internal definition.
- Evidence checklist references: kibana dashboards, retention windows (60 days by default), trace sampling rates, and an ops runbook (on-call + escalation matrix).

Attachments: medxpress-sla-annex-draft.pdf; evidence-checklist.xlsx; orderform-snippet.md

Can you confirm: (a) whether MedXpress needs SOC 2 letter or full CSVs of telemetry, and (b) the procurement contact to kick DocuSign routing? If you want, we can route a redline-ready order form to you by tomorrow morning for procurement review.

Next steps we propose:
1) We send redline-ready order form to your procurement.
2) Your legal files a single set of redlines (we'll track in DocuSign).
3) We deliver evidence artifacts into the shared drive link and schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with your security team.

If helpful I can get Grace (our Solutions lead) on a call this afternoon to walk the telemetry checklist end-to-end.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: medxpress-sla-annex-draft.pdf] [Attachment: evidence-checklist.xlsx] [Attachment: orderform-snippet.md]

From: Caroline Park <caroline.park@medxpress.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: MedXpress Procurement <procurement@medxpress.com>, Andrew Li <andrew.li@medxpress.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedXpress: request for custom uptime/latency annex and order form language

Thanks Jonas — this looks like a solid start. A few immediate comments from procurement/security:

- Credit structure: procurement prefers a flat-days-credit model for p99 breaches rather than tokenized bands; can you provide a mapping table (band -> days credit) so we can evaluate financial exposure?
- Evidence: we will need SOC 2 Type II report and the telemetry extracts for a representative 7-day window for the last 30 days. If you cannot export CSVs, a short walkthrough with your SE and access to dashboards is acceptable.
- DocuSign: procurement@medxpress.com is the primary inbox. Please route the order form to that address. We also require that the order form include a single-line item referencing the appendix ID (e.g., "Appendix A — Availability Annex DX-2026-089").

Can you get the redline-ready order form and the band->days credit mapping to us by EOB tomorrow? We may ask for a short call with Grace to confirm the telemetry fields.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Caroline
